notes.title: Recursive Ruin — Steam Next Fest Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

If you've stumbled upon our trippy little corner of the internet through the Steam Next Fest, welcome! Recursive Ruin is a kaleidoscopic narrative-driven puzzle game in which you explore an infinitely repeating world of strange beauty and mind-bending physics. 

[previewyoutube=9cR93b6mcAw;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo includes the first chapter of the game, which sets the tone of the story and has you flexing your problem-solving muscles as you get a taste of the Infinite Realms. We can't say too much more without going into spoiler territory, so go experience the demo for yourself!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561890/Recursive_Ruin/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/8af1d780e1f078205a8a37febd322c048ddf11e4.gif[/img]

For those who tried the demo earlier, we've changed some things based on your feedback, such as the ability to skip through dialogue, which is something a few people requested. Give the updated demo a try, and let us know what you think!

[url=https://discord.gg/iceberginteractive][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41241215/82613840e165385270bb8a71e2bf9693a37e51de.png[/img][/url]
